# Every test target, test-only feature and pending #[ignore] of the pack and its fuzz crate
# (fuzz/, its own workspace); scripts/check-targets.sh reads this file and checks it. One row per
# line: PACKAGE|KIND|NAME|FEATURES|PARTS, the format and the rules in scripts/check-targets.sh's
# header. The part is `check`: scripts/check.sh. A row whose PARTS holds "pending ruling" waits
# on a decision; none may be left when a change lands (CHECK_TARGETS_LANDING=1).
